sections.heading: Q3 strategic update — draft
paragraphs: This is an in-progress draft. Akki and I are co-authoring the strategic update for the EC in the editor. Once final, we will commit to lock and export.

The capital allocation question is the single most material item queued for Q3. The bank has projected $42M of CET1 headroom by year-end; allocating that headroom to SME lending versus accelerating digital transformation versus holding for capital strength is the choice the board will need to take.
